constraints.description: Every bounded React plan acceptance criterion must map to reproducible current evidence.

validation.validation_method: acceptance matrix and evidence path checks

constraints.description: Source-workspace browser evidence must remain distinct from tarball-only package evidence.

validation.validation_method: receipt boundary assertions and packed-package report

constraints.description: All nine React-owned scenario IDs plus DevTools diagnostics must have passing evidence.

validation.validation_method: coverage verifier and browser receipt assertions

constraints.description: Implementation and clean-room browser evidence must remain separately named, hash-matched, and free of serious or critical axe violations.
Coverage, docs, OpenSpec tasks, Changesets, and evidence paths must agree on the implemented React state and incomplete full release.

validation.validation_method: coverage, OpenSpec, Changesets, JSON, and file checks

constraints.description: Uncertified browsers/live integrations and current broader Flutter/Tauri/full-portfolio blockers must remain explicit and unwaived.
QA may certify implementation but must not claim npm publication, immutable-source certification, or authority to split the twelve-package fixed group.

global_rules: Use current repository evidence as authoritative.
Do not convert an external/manual gate into a passing repository claim.
Do not mutate npm or any other public release state.
Lead reflection with gaps and deltas rather than success claims.
termination_conditions: Both manifest variants exist and are non-empty.
Manifest, constraints, and refinement state validate.
No material correction remains before fresh adversarial review.
